title: Extended Warranty is a SCAM! Here's Why
summary: A money-focused creator argues the extended warranty industry is engineered to deny claims via maintenance and pre-existing-condition traps, and recommends self-insuring instead.

assertions.quote: how much of that they pay back in actual repairs? Less than 12 cents on the dollar
If you can't prove every oil change, every inspection done exactly on their schedule, they can void your entire claim
that inspector's job is not to help you, it's to find something, anything, that could be called a prior issue
they exclude what always breaks, the seals, the gaskets, the sensors
CarShield, one of the most advertised warranty companies, was banned from selling in California

verdicts.note: Documented regulatory action exists against at least one heavily advertised provider.

assertions.quote: Instead of paying $200 a year for a warranty, save it
use a credit card with purchase protection. Many cards automatically extend warranties

verdicts.note: A standard, named benefit on many major credit cards.
CR says many credit cards automatically extend a manufacturer's warranty up to about a year on products bought entirely with the card, at no cost.
